review_title: Comparative effects of interventions on female sexual function and sexual distress: a systematic review with clinically stratified Bayesian network and dose-response meta-analyses

official_record_content_observed.population: Women18orolder; mixed-sex/mixed-age studies require separately extractable randomized data for adult women; sex/gender definitions recorded as reported.
official_record_content_observed.main_outcomes: Global sexual function and sexually related personal distress separately; standard weightedFSFI19 distinct from modified/uncertain versions.
official_record_content_observed.main_window: Closest to12weeks within8–16weeks after randomization, later if tied; other windows retained.
official_record_content_observed.review_roles: The registered plan specified independent screening by two reviewers and adjudication by a third. AI-assisted checks do not constitute independent human review.
official_record_content_observed.synthesis: Bayesian pairwise/network and within-modality dose-response conditional on clinically coherent independent comparisons, network and data support; pairwise or structured narrative when not supported.
official_record_content_observed.preparatory_work: The public record explicitly discloses2711 public candidate records,120-record AI feasibility pilot, selective numerical outcome inspection/extraction before registration; formal review-wide human procedures and pooled models not completed at submission.
